title: Item Shadows
description: Adds drop shadows for inventory items and hotbar
body:
Adds a simple drop shadow to every rendered item in the GUI, configurable via YACL and ModMenu

Can be laggy as it renders every item twice

![Items with drop shadows](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bd0ef56ac5e095f2db834124055180b9cda81f0d.png)
